tools.name: clasify
tools.shortDescription: Classify unread text/images or held data; answers without source bodies.
tools.fields: evaluate[questions*, assets?, longContext?, model?, source?, state?] | models[] | sections[questions*, resources*, longContext?, model?] | sectionsResume[assessment*]
tools.help:
Input: one query object, or {"queries":[…]} to batch.

Required fields, by operation:
  evaluate  questions
  models    operation
  sections  operation, resources, questions
  sections  operation, assessment

Example:
  octocode clasify '{
    "state": "Create a replacement credential, then restart the service.",
    "questions": {"restart":{"type":"noul","instructions":"Does rotating the credential require restarting the service?"}}
  }'

All fields: octocode schema clasify

tools.help:
Input: one query object, or {"queries":[…]} to batch.

Required fields, by operation:
  definition       path, symbolName, line
  documentSymbols  path, operation
  workspaceSymbol  path, operation, symbolName
  workspaceSymbol  operation, symbolName, workspaceRoot

Example:
  octocode lspSearch '{"path":"src/index.ts","operation":"definition","symbolName":"run","line":10}'

All fields: octocode schema lspSearch

query.name: lspSearch
query.description: Resolve symbol identity, references, callers, types or diagnostics. resolvedSymbol reports a corrected input anchor, not a different definition target. Syntax fallbacks do not verify identity. Empty workspaceSymbol is not absence; Python misses uninferred receivers; Rust build scripts/proc-macros need rustContext. Also accepts: pageSize, includeDeclaration, contextLines, graphDepth. <workflow>decisive result lines → localFetch ranges</workflow>

path.description: Anchor file; workspaceSymbol may name a directory.

symbolName.description: Exact identifier; workspaceSymbol accepts a search term.

line.description: 1-based line hint; may move within five lines. Check resolvedSymbol.foundAtLine.

orderHint.description: 0-based occurrence on line; resolvedSymbol.alternatives lists them.

workspaceRoot.description: Project root; workspaceSymbol may omit path.

querySchema.description: Also required — all but documentSymbols/diagnostic/workspaceSymbol: path+symbolName+line; documentSymbols/diagnostic: path; workspaceSymbol: path+symbolName or symbolName+workspaceRoot. By operation — orderHint: not documentSymbols/diagnostic/workspaceSymbol.
